question: At what point in practice does a particular effect begin with respect to the root wheel?
premises: The root wheel is the object first taken up.
At the time another practice is undertaken, a temporal condition holds.
The address marks the beloved as recipient of instruction.
inference: When, O beloved, one first practices the root wheel or undertakes another practice at that time, the stated condition holds.
uncertainties: The main clause following the temporal clause is not present in these tokens.
plain_english: When, O beloved, one first practices the root wheel, or when another practice is undertaken...
